summary: Focused retest of normalize_phone fix (iteration 5 action item). All 7 tests passed (7/7 = 100%). Garbage phone strings ('abc', '---', 'xyz') correctly return 400 with 'Phone must be E.164' on POST /api/members, PUT /api/members/{id}, and PUT /api/auth/me. Empty string and missing phone_number field still create members with phone_number=null. Valid E.164 phone (+1415555XXXX) normalizes and persists correctly. Test members cleaned up via teardown fixture.
critical_code_review_comments: normalize_phone fix is correct: raw non-empty string that strips to empty digits now raises HTTPException 400. Empty/whitespace/None still returns None, so members can be created without a phone.
Same normalize_phone is reused in POST /api/members, PUT /api/members/{id}, and PUT /api/auth/me — validation is uniform across endpoints.
seed_data_creation: Created 4 transient TEST members during regression; all cleaned up via module-scoped teardown fixture (DELETE /api/members/{id}).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration 5 action item is fully resolved. Auth login endpoint uses 'identifier' key (falls back to email). Member create/get response is wrapped as {'member': {...}} — use unwrap helper. Phone uniqueness enforced via partial unique index; use randomized phones in regression tests to avoid 409 conflicts.
